== Summary ==
Players Committee D-E1 card image of Gravity Shadow, shown on [[Gravity Shadow (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]. Source: Holotable image <code>Images-HT/starwars/JediPack-Dark/large/gravityshadow.gif</code>; high-resolution PNG first committed in swccgpc/holotable commit <code>68f360e</code> (“Recent errata and fixes”, 19 February 2023, UTC; full hash <code>68f360e2267b93314bec3b27e3797d5b355171d8</code>); card-size GIF in swccgpc/holotable commit <code>9e3d992</code> (“Fixing case and making gifs”, 20 February 2023, UTC; full hash <code>9e3d9929eb170ded7c439b48f806e67eb656faf7</code>). The PC served the image at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/JediPack-Dark/large/gravityshadow.gif gravityshadow.gif]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009025951/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/JediPack-Dark/large/gravityshadow.gif Internet Archive] (9 October 2026).

Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
